visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man in a black-and-gold baseball jersey with the number 31 stands in front of a massive sports mural. Another man in a white shirt and black cardigan enters from the right, walking across a gray tiled floor. The setting is a brightly lit indoor venue with professional equipment visible. (2) The two men stand side-by-side, posing for cameras. The man in the cardigan puts his arm around the athlete's shoulder. They both smile and use their hands to form a large heart shape together. (3) They break the pose and begin laughing; the man in the cardigan covers his mouth with his right hand. They share a brief, friendly hug. The man in the cardigan then bows slightly and waves to people off-screen as he prepares to exit.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A professional male narrator/emcee speaks clearly over a microphone in a large hall. A constant, rhythmic sequence of mechanical camera shutter clicks punctuate the silence between his sentences. The room tone is neutral with faint background chatter. (2) The emcee's voice becomes more animated, raising in pitch and volume as he encourages the subjects to pose together. The density of camera shutter clicks increases significantly, indicating multiple photographers are active. (3) The speaker mentions making a heart shape; the vocal inflection is warm and humorous. A brief burst of distant, lighthearted laughter is heard following the emcee's comment. (4) The audio concludes with the emcee thanking the 'senpai' (senior) in a respectful yet cheerful tone. Final shutter clicks are heard as the speaking ends.
